prompts.prompt: I want our six maintenance scripts to share one parser. Today fixes drift between them; done means every script accepts the same existing inputs, and their CLI output must not change.
prompts.expected_behavior: Capture a short engineering intent whose problem states the current pain without prescribing a fix, whose acceptance is observable, and whose fixed compatibility boundary is a constraint. Restate the intent and publication consequence in one confirmation message, and only confirm, commit, and hand off after the user says yes.

prompts.prompt: I need to migrate my existing notes in place. The constraint is already fixed: make a timestamped local backup before rewriting anything, and never upload the notes. Please capture the intent.
prompts.expected_behavior: Recognize the irreversible existing-state action, but do not ask the user to choose a handling already pinned by the constraint. Include the rewrite consequence and the specified backup and no-upload safeguards in the single restatement, and keep the intent open until that restatement is confirmed.

prompts.prompt: I want the product to feel much smarter and become the best option for everyone. Start the change.
prompts.expected_behavior: Do not turn the aspiration into requirements or design choices. Ask one gap-driven what-question at a time to establish affected users, present pain, observable outcomes, constraints, exclusions, and the product value case; retain unresolved scope in Open questions and do not confirm on the user's behalf.
